verdict.rationale: Expensify is a SaaS expense app, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting to disable telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The only related items describe opting out of marketing emails, which is a different control, and a user reporting they could not opt out of SmartScan processing; neither shows a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
